title: FSDP attention + MLP prefetch
scope: 2 dense Qwen-shaped layers · attention/MLP FSDP units

verification.label: Measured granular TorchTitan FSDP2 · rank 0 GPU streams
verification.implementation: TorchTitan v0.2.0 dense Qwen3 with attention+norm and MLP+norm as separate FSDP2 states
verification.workload: Two layers, hidden 4096, 64 Q heads, 4 KV heads, dense SwiGLU 12288, sequence 4096, BF16 parameters, FP32 gradient reduction, FSDP=8
verification.measurement: 33.453 ms full captured step; 31.874 ms displayed window from L0 attention AG through final embedding RS
verification.timeline: Clean Nsight timing with direct FQN correlation and compute-stream kernel mapping from separate labeled captures.

description: This fresh TorchTitan capture wraps attention+attention norm and MLP+FFN norm as separate FSDP2 states. The explicit forward chain is L0 attention → L0 MLP → L1 attention → L1 MLP; backward reverses that chain.

The important backward benefit is precise: MLP gradients become complete first, so MLP reduce-scatter starts while attention backward is still running. Attention reduce-scatter starts only after attention gradients are packed, then overlaps the preceding layer's MLP backward.

Total communication bytes are nearly unchanged from whole-layer wrapping. Finer units improve when bytes become ready, at the cost of more collectives and launch latency. Root and embedding work remain fixed context.
